# Tabler

This directory contains the locally hosted browser assets used by the CostPilot
Executive Dashboard pilot.

- Package: `@tabler/core`
- Version: `1.4.0`
- Project: https://tabler.io
- Source: https://github.com/tabler/tabler
- License: MIT

The package metadata is retained in `package.json`. CostPilot loads these files
locally and does not require a runtime CDN connection.
